name: toggle
useFor: Use Toggle for one on or off tool in a toolbar (watch a thread, bold). Give icon-only toggles an aria-label. For a set of related toggles use ToggleGroup; for a setting use Switch.
constraints: A toggle that scales on press
source: The Hoplite website's nav items (.hn__top), its outlined key (.button--line) and the chosen pricing period (.pr-period__option:has(:checked))
title: Toggle
description: A two-state key shaped like the site's nav item: a compact 32px hexagon whose hover wash appears under the pointer; pressed, it is a filled ink hexagon with a ground-colored label. outline is the outlined hexagon that fills with the ink.
